<details>

However, as presented, the script is not executable in its current encoded form, suggesting it may have been improperly rendered. Assuming the quotes are corrected to standard shell syntax (`"`), the script remains benign.

This file acts as a straightforward launcher and does not introduce any supply-chain risks.
</details>

</details>
